title: Stretch Senior Development Finance UK
summary: Product page for Silver Oak Capital's stretch senior development finance. Search results reveal the core description: a single high-leverage facility from one lender that combines the leverage of senior debt and mezzanine finance, 'stretching' higher than a standard senior development loan. The firm says it can help secure up to 75% of Gross Development Value (GDV) or 90% Loan to Cost (LTC) in a single transaction; the product often carries tighter controls and covenants, and avoids a second lender (so no Intercreditor Deed between senior and junior lenders). The site FAQ adds that stretch senior lenders typically have a minimum loan size of about £1m-£2m, can fund projects up to £50m+, and may cap commercial schemes at 65% LTGDV. H1, meta description, process steps and CTAs were not revealed by search snippets. Contradictions noted: an older /types-of-borrowing/ example shows 75% LTGDV / 85% LTC and the Scotland article says up to 85% of total costs, versus 90% LTC on this page.
